test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 22 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the name of DRDO's homegrown multi-layered defense system, showcased for the first time at the 2025 Republic Day parade and Aero India 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rakshak-Suraksha Kavach**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Rakshak-Suraksha Kavach** is an advanced, homegrown **multi-layered air defense system** developed by the **Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO)** to provide comprehensive protection against a variety of aerial threats.
 
• This sophisticated system made its debut appearance at the **76th Republic Day Parade** held on **January 26, 2025**, at **Kartavya Path**, **New Delhi**, showcasing India’s growing prowess in defense manufacturing.
 
• It was also a major highlight at **Aero India 2025**, the **15th edition** of the biennial air show held at the **Yelahanka Air Force Station** in **Bengaluru**, **Karnataka**.
 
• The **Rakshak-Suraksha Kavach** is designed to integrate various existing and new missile systems into a single **Command and Control (C2)** architecture, creating a "seamless shield" for the country's critical infrastructure and airspace.
 
• The system is specifically engineered to detect, track, and neutralize threats such as **ballistic missiles**, **cruise missiles**, **fighter jets**, and **unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs)** or **drone swarms** at multiple ranges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation):**
 
 
• Established in **1958**, **DRDO** is the R&D wing of the **Ministry of Defence**, Government of India, with its headquarters in **New Delhi**.
 
• It is responsible for the design and development of state-of-the-art **defense technologies**, including **missiles**, **armored vehicles**, **radars**, and **electronic warfare systems**.
 
 
 
• **Aero India 2025:**
 
 
• This event is Asia’s largest **aerospace and defense exhibition**, providing a platform for **Aatmanirbhar Bharat** (Self-reliant India) to demonstrate its **indigenous aviation** and **aerospace capabilities**.
 
• The **2025** edition focused on the **Viksit Bharat @ 2047** vision, emphasizing the export potential of Indian-made defense hardware to the global market.
 
 
 
• **Multi-Layered Defense Architecture:**
 
 
• A multi-layered system typically consists of **Very Short Range Air Defence (VSHORAD)** for close-in protection, **Medium Range Surface-to-Air Missiles (MRSAM)**, and **Long Range** interceptors.
 
• The **Kavach** system acts as the central nervous system that synchronizes **radars** and **launchers** to ensure zero-gap security.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Technological Features:** The **Rakshak-Suraksha Kavach** utilizes **Active Electronically Scanned Array (AESA)** radars for **360-degree surveillance** and **precision tracking** of high-speed targets.
 
• **Strategic Significance:** The deployment of this homegrown system reduces **India's** dependency on foreign air defense platforms like the **S-400 Triumf** from **Russia** or the **Iron Dome** from **Israel**.
 
• **Collaboration:** The project involved collaboration between **DRDO**, various **Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)** like **Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL)**, and private industry partners under the **Make in India** initiative.
 
• **Modern Warfare Adaptation:** The inclusion of **anti-drone** modules within the **Kavach** system highlights its readiness for **asymmetric warfare** and **cyber-electronic** threats prevalent in modern conflicts.
